_readme: Student photos for the leaderboards, keyed by GitHub username (lowercase).
Keys are matched case-insensitively; keys starting with _ are ignored.
Value is a site-relative path, e.g. images/students/kachiraju.jpg.
Anyone missing here falls back to their initials, and a broken path also
falls back to initials rather than showing a broken image.
This file is deliberately separate from data/leaderboard.csv: review-agent
regenerates that CSV every night and auto-publishes it, so a photo column
added there would be overwritten within a day. Nothing writes this file
To add one: drop the image in images/students/, then add a line below.
Square images work best; they are cropped to a 40px circle.
